outcome: The simulator's Rust code is tidied, with every result proven unchanged
owner_impact: Nothing changes in how the Lab looks, behaves or computes. The Rust simulator code now uses standard formatting, a normal file structure instead of an unusual file-inclusion trick, and a few harmless shortcuts rewritten in their standard form. The recorded reference runs prove that every agent position and every metric value is bit-for-bit identical, both in the browser's simulator and the native one, and the simulator's browser interface is byte-identical. CI now also rejects unformatted Rust code.

next.text: Next is #541 — one shared database connection in the browser: the Lab currently opens 8 separate connections to its database (7 sharing your login), which I will replace with one shared connection without changing what you see or how you sign in. #541 has not started.
